records.name: Dormant-entity claim syndicate
records.text: Dormant entities act as employers and training providers to submit false grant claims

records.name: Forged evidence during checks
records.text: False records are provided when claims are checked or audited

records.name: Credit encashment
records.text: Individuals submit false claims without attending a course

records.name: Cash for enrolment
records.text: Agents or recruiters offer cash for using credits and suggest attendance is optional

records.name: Falsified attendance
records.text: Attendance is recorded for training that did not take place

records.name: Employment created for grants
records.text: People are hired only to attend a course and are let go afterwards

records.name: Overclaimed training
records.text: Claims exceed the training or attendance actually delivered

records.name: Indirect kickback through a sponsor
records.text: A sponsor pays the nett fee while value flows back through the provider

records.name: S1
